description: Creates a team group (the internal back office) with rights on forms and reports. tables_permissions gives access at creation: an array of table (the id or name of a form or report), role (the numbers are in its own description), only_own_records, hidden_fields (names or ids of the fields to hide).

hidden_fields.description: Names or IDs of the hidden fields

role.description: 1=administrator: everything, as the owner; 2=read only; 3=read, write and DELETE records; 4=read, write and DELETE records, and build forms; 5=read and write records, NO delete; 6=read, edit and DELETE records; 7=read and edit records, NO delete. When the person asked that these people cannot delete, pass only a role that says NO delete (or read only), never one that says DELETE; and tell the person what the role lets them do in these words. «Admin» on the screen is role 1.

table.description: ID or name of the form/report

name: create_team_group
